reason: Adds a DSH Web UI settings page for selecting and saving reasoning-effort levels on models explicitly configured in custom providers.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自定义提供商中的模型添加设置页面，用于选择并保存可用的推理强度级别。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness settings page for selecting and saving available reasoning-effort levels for models in custom providers.

capabilities: Adds a settings page to the DSH Web UI
Lists models configured for custom providers
Updates per-model reasoning effort settings through the DSH settings service
Preserves other model fields and existing provider-specific values
